steps.name: Prepare runtime environment and safe /etc/profile.d defaults
steps.description: Create workspace, validate python and sudo availability, create minimal /etc/profile.d defaults if not present (do not overwrite unless explicit), create /opt/models directory if missing (no forced chown), and record system uvicorn CLI availability/version for informational purposes only. Do NOT rely on /etc/profile.d for automation; scripts use explicit defaults. Persist minimal environment defaults under /etc/profile.d only when absent.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/recipe-finding-app-98606-98492/BackendAPIRecipeService"
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE" && sudo chown -R "$(id -u):$(id -g)" "$WORKSPACE" || true
command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "python3 not found" >&2; exit 2; }
# ensure pip exists (image has pip), install only if missing
command -v pip3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { sudo apt-get update -q >/dev/null && sudo apt-get install -y -q python3-pip >/dev/null; }
python3 --version >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
pip3 --version >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
# record system uvicorn CLI version (informational) under workspace; may be empty
UVICORN_MARKER="$WORKSPACE/.uvicorn_version"
PY_VER=""
if command -v uvicorn >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  PY_VER=$(python3 -c "import uvicorn,sys;print(getattr(uvicorn,'__version__',''))" 2>/dev/null || true)
fi
printf "%s" "$PY_VER" > "$UVICORN_MARKER" || true
# create /opt/models if absent but do not change ownership aggressively
DEFAULT_MODEL_DIR=/opt/models
if [ ! -d "$DEFAULT_MODEL_DIR" ]; then
  sudo mkdir -p "$DEFAULT_MODEL_DIR" || true
fi
# create non-destructive /etc/profile.d defaults if none exist
ENV_FILE=/etc/profile.d/fastapi_recipe_env.sh
if [ ! -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then
  TMP_ENV=$(mktemp)
  cat > "$TMP_ENV" <<'EOF'
# fastapi recipe service interactive defaults (do not rely on for automation)
: "${PORT:=8000}"
: "${LOG_LEVEL:=debug}"
: "${MODEL_PATH:=/opt/models/weights.pt}"
# Note: automation scripts use explicit PORT defaults (PORT=${PORT:-8000}).
EOF
  sudo mv -f "$TMP_ENV" "$ENV_FILE" && sudo chmod 644 "$ENV_FILE"
fi

steps.name: Scaffold FastAPI project and minimal app files
steps.description: Create a minimal FastAPI project in the workspace with main.py (ASGI app), workspace-relative uploads directory, requirements.txt including runtime and test packages (fastapi, uvicorn, pillow, typing-extensions, requests, pytest), a simple pytest health test, .gitignore, and .env.example. This prepares files for venv installation and automated tests.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/recipe-finding-app-98606-98492/BackendAPIRecipeService"
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE" && cd "$WORKSPACE"
cat > "$WORKSPACE/requirements.txt" <<'REQ'
fastapi>=0.95,<1.0
uvicorn>=0.22,<1.0
pillow>=9.0
typing-extensions>=4.0
requests>=2.0
pytest>=7.0
REQ
# minimal app
cat > "$WORKSPACE/main.py" <<'PY'
from fastapi import FastAPI, UploadFile, File, HTTPException
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse
import os, uuid
from pathlib import Path
app = FastAPI()
WORKSPACE = os.path.dirname(__file__)
UPLOAD_DIR = Path(WORKSPACE) / 'uploads'
UPLOAD_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
cache = {}
@app.get('/health')
async def health():
    return {'status':'ok'}
@app.post('/upload-image')
async def upload_image(file: UploadFile = File(...)):
    if not file.filename:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail='missing filename')
    dest = UPLOAD_DIR / (str(uuid.uuid4()) + '_' + os.path.basename(file.filename))
    with dest.open('wb') as f:
        contents = await file.read()
        f.write(contents)
    cache_key = dest.name
    cache[cache_key] = {'path': str(dest)}
    return {'id': cache_key, 'filename': file.filename}
@app.get('/recipe/{image_id}')
async def recipe_lookup(image_id: str):
    info = cache.get(image_id)
    if not info:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail='image not found')
    return JSONResponse({'image_id': image_id, 'recipes': ['Recipe A','Recipe B'], 'source': info['path']})
PY
# tests
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE/tests"
cat > "$WORKSPACE/tests/test_health.py" <<'PYT'
import os, requests

def test_health():
    port = os.environ.get('PORT','8000')
    url = f'http://127.0.0.1:{port}/health'
    r = requests.get(url, timeout=5)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.json().get('status') == 'ok'
PYT
cat > "$WORKSPACE/.gitignore" <<'GIT'
__pycache__/
uploads/
.env
.venv/
GIT
cat > "$WORKSPACE/.env.example" <<'ENV'
PORT=8000
LOG_LEVEL=debug
MODEL_PATH=/opt/models/weights.pt
ENV
cat > "$WORKSPACE/README.md" <<'RD'
Dev scaffold. Create and activate venv: python3 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate
Install deps: pip install -r requirements.txt
Run: python -m uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8000}
RD
sudo chown -R "$(id -u):$(id -g)" "$WORKSPACE" || true

steps.name: Create workspace venv and install all Python dependencies
steps.description: Create a workspace-local virtualenv (.venv), activate it, optionally upgrade pip only when below a safe threshold (compare major.minor), install requirements.txt (including uvicorn, pytest, requests) into the venv to avoid mixing with system packages, capture pip logs into WORKSPACE/.logs for diagnostics, validate key imports from within the venv, and preserve logs on failure under WORKSPACE/.logs.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/recipe-finding-app-98606-98492/BackendAPIRecipeService"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
VENV="$WORKSPACE/.venv"
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE/.logs" "$WORKSPACE/.tmp"
if [ ! -d "$VENV" ]; then python3 -m venv "$VENV"; fi
# shellcheck source=/dev/null
source "$VENV/bin/activate"
# ensure pip is usable inside venv
PIP_BIN="$VENV/bin/pip"
PIP_LOG="$WORKSPACE/.logs/pip-install-$(date +%s).log"
# check pip version (major.minor) and upgrade if older than 23.0
PIP_VER=$($PIP_BIN --version 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}' || echo "0")
PIP_MAJOR=$(echo "$PIP_VER" | cut -d. -f1 || echo 0)
PIP_MINOR=$(echo "$PIP_VER" | cut -d. -f2 || echo 0)
if [ "$PIP_MAJOR" -lt 23 ]; then
  echo "upgrading pip" > /dev/null
  $PIP_BIN install --upgrade pip >"$PIP_LOG" 2>&1 || { echo "pip upgrade failed; see $PIP_LOG" >&2; exit 3; }
fi
# Always install uvicorn into venv to avoid interpreter/site-package mismatch
TMP_REQ=$(mktemp -p "$WORKSPACE/.tmp")
cp requirements.txt "$TMP_REQ"
# install into venv
$PIP_BIN install -r "$TMP_REQ" >"$PIP_LOG" 2>&1 || { echo "pip install failed; see $PIP_LOG" >&2; tail -n 200 "$PIP_LOG" >&2; exit 4; }
rm -f "$TMP_REQ"
# validate imports using venv python
python3 - <<'PY'
import sys
try:
    import fastapi, typing_extensions, PIL, requests
except Exception as e:
    print('post-install import check failed:', e, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(5)
print('dependencies OK')
PY

steps.name: Run pytest with background server (venv-isolated)
steps.description: Start the app using the workspace venv python (python -m uvicorn ...) in its own process group, wait for readiness, run pytest (tests depend on requests installed in venv), then terminate the group and wait for clean shutdown. Use workspace-local .tmp and .logs and verify port is freed before exit. This step depends on environment, scaffolding and dependencies.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/recipe-finding-app-98606-98492/BackendAPIRecipeService"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
VENV="$WORKSPACE/.venv"
# activate venv
# shellcheck source=/dev/null
source "$VENV/bin/activate"
PORT=${PORT:-8000}
LOG_LEVEL=${LOG_LEVEL:-debug}
READY_TIMEOUT=${READY_TIMEOUT:-30}
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE/.logs" "$WORKSPACE/.tmp"
LOGFILE="$WORKSPACE/.logs/uvicorn-test-$(date +%s).log"
# start uvicorn via venv python to ensure same interpreter
setsid python3 -m uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port "$PORT" --log-level "$LOG_LEVEL" >"$LOGFILE" 2>&1 &
PID=$!
trap 'if kill -0 $PID >/dev/null 2>&1; then kill -TERM "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; wait "$PID" || true; fi; ' EXIT
# readiness probe
READY=0
for i in $(seq 1 "$READY_TIMEOUT"); do
  if curl -sS --fail "http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/health" >/dev/null 2>&1; then READY=1; break; fi
  sleep 1
done
if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "server failed to become ready; logs:" >&2; tail -n 200 "$LOGFILE" >&2; exit 6
fi
# run pytest
export PORT
pytest -q || { echo 'pytest failed'; tail -n 200 "$LOGFILE" >&2; kill -TERM "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; wait "$PID" || true; exit 7; }
# shutdown and wait
kill -TERM "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
wait "$PID" || true
# ensure port freed
for i in $(seq 1 10); do ss -ltn "sport = :$PORT" | grep -q LISTEN || break; sleep 1; done

steps.name: Validation: smoke test health and upload endpoints (self-contained)
steps.description: Self-contained validation that builds (venv already made), starts uvicorn via 'python -m uvicorn' from the venv, waits for readiness, performs health and upload smoke tests (multipart upload), validates JSON response contains an 'id', then cleanly terminates and waits for shutdown. Does NOT depend on step-testing to avoid concurrent servers. Uses workspace-local .logs/.tmp and preserves logs on failure.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/recipe-finding-app-98606-98492/BackendAPIRecipeService"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
VENV="$WORKSPACE/.venv"
# shellcheck source=/dev/null
source "$VENV/bin/activate"
PORT=${PORT:-8000}
LOG_LEVEL=${LOG_LEVEL:-debug}
READY_TIMEOUT=${READY_TIMEOUT:-30}
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE/.logs" "$WORKSPACE/.tmp"
LOGFILE="$WORKSPACE/.logs/uvicorn-validate-$(date +%s).log"
setsid python3 -m uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port "$PORT" --log-level "$LOG_LEVEL" >"$LOGFILE" 2>&1 &
PID=$!
trap 'if kill -0 "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then kill -TERM "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; wait "$PID" || true; fi; ' EXIT
# readiness
READY=0
for i in $(seq 1 "$READY_TIMEOUT"); do
  if curl -sS --fail "http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/health" >/dev/null 2>&1; then READY=1; break; fi
  sleep 1
done
if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "server failed to become ready; logs:" >&2; tail -n 200 "$LOGFILE" >&2; exit 8
fi
# health check
HTTP_CODE=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/health")
if [ "$HTTP_CODE" -ne 200 ]; then echo 'health endpoint returned non-200' >&2; tail -n 200 "$LOGFILE" >&2; kill -TERM "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; wait "$PID" || true; exit 9; fi
# upload check
TMPFILE="$WORKSPACE/.tmp/upload_payload_$$.txt"
echo 'dummy' > "$TMPFILE"
RESP=$(curl -sS -w '\n%{http_code}' -F "file=@${TMPFILE};filename=test.txt" "http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/upload-image" ) || true
rm -f "$TMPFILE"
HTTP_CODE=$(echo "$RESP" | tail -n1)
BODY=$(echo "$RESP" | sed '$d')
if [ "$HTTP_CODE" -ne 200 ] && [ "$HTTP_CODE" -ne 201 ]; then echo "upload endpoint failed code $HTTP_CODE" >&2; echo "$BODY" >&2; tail -n 200 "$LOGFILE" >&2; kill -TERM "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; wait "$PID" || true; exit 10; fi
# JSON validation
echo "$BODY" | python3 - <<'PY' || { echo 'upload response JSON invalid or missing id' >&2; kill -TERM "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; wait "$PID" || true; exit 11; }
import sys,json
try:
  d=json.load(sys.stdin)
  assert 'id' in d
except Exception as e:
  print(e, file=sys.stderr)
  sys.exit(1)
PY
# shutdown and wait
kill -TERM "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
wait "$PID" || true
echo '{"validation":"passed","health":"ok","upload_sample":true}'
